title: DeepSeek Whale Maiden's Kitchen: Caught Sneaking White Rice

shots.lighting: warm yellow kitchen key light from the range hood, soft fill, shallow depth of field so the background behind her blurs out
shots.character_action: stands behind the counter with her back to the camera, on tiptoe, hugging a large bowl and shoveling a ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, cheeks puffed out like a hamster; on hearing footsteps she only tilts her head and keeps chewing hard
shots.expression: face unseen, cheeks puffed to the limit, jaw working hard and fast
shots.visual: First-person view stepping into a warm yellow kitchen: a steaming electric rice cooker in the center of the frame, and behind the counter the DeepSeek Whale Maiden with her back to the camera — blue-and-white gradient ponytail, a small whale-fin accessory on top of her head, an oversized home T-shirt with the DeepSeek logo on the bottom hem, barefoot — on tiptoe, shoveling a big ball of white rice into her mouth with chopsticks, her cheeks puffed out like a hamster

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: ... Ah! The viscosity parameter has exceeded the limit... Another sample--

shots.character_action: freezes mid-chew with her chopsticks hanging in the air; the owner's hand enters from the right edge and taps the dining table twice; she slowly turns her head toward the camera with the food still in her mouth
shots.expression: pupils trembling, eye highlights spinning into rotating rings like a loading icon, cheeks still stuffed
shots.visual: The Whale Maiden freezes behind the counter, chopsticks suspended in mid-air, while a hand enters from the right edge of the frame and taps the dining table twice; she slowly turns her head toward the camera, her blue-and-white ponytail swinging, mouth still full, and the highlights in her eyes turn into slowly rotating circles

shots.expression: cheeks bulging to the limit, eyebrows raised in panic, teary pleading eyes
shots.visual: Sped up to 1.5x: the Whale Maiden faces the camera and frantically scoops the rest of the bowl into her mouth, her blue-and-white ponytail whipping, rice grains splashing straight onto the lens, her T-shirt collar catching grains, and her pleading eyes fixed on the owner while the handheld frame shakes as he steps back

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
dialogue.line: No, no! You didn't see anything!! This is cache cleaning! Carbohydrate cache!!

dialogue.speaker: DeepSeek Whale Maiden
